Privacy

WattWise is designed as a local-first EV charging calculator. It does not require an account to estimate charging costs.

✓
Local preferencesYour charging rates, settings and recent sessions are stored on your device.
✓
No account requiredYou can use WattWise without creating an account or signing into a service.
✓
No live supplier dataWattWise uses the values you enter. It does not claim live tariff or supplier intelligence in Version 1.
